panels.title: Cluster health
panels.description: Healthy: 4 expected nodes Ready, no operator problems or critical/warning alerts. Attention: warnings or progressing operators. Unhealthy: missing/unready nodes, unavailable/degraded/failing operators, or critical alerts. Unknown: required monitoring sources or Watchdog missing/down/stale (>180 seconds). Query errors must be treated as unknown.

targets.expr: (clamp_max(2 * (clamp_max(((sum(max by (node) ((kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status="true",node=~"ms\\-02|ms\\-03|ms\\-04|tr\\-gpu"} and (time() - timestamp(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status="true",node=~"ms\\-02|ms\\-03|ms\\-04|tr\\-gpu"}) < 180)))) or vector(0)) != bool 4) + ((count(count by (name) (cluster_operator_conditions{condition="Available"} == 0 or cluster_operator_conditions{condition=~"Degraded|Failing"} == 1)) or vector(0)) > bool 0) + ((count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="critical"}) or vector(0)) > bool 0), 1)) + (clamp_max(((count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="warning"}) or vector(0)) > bool 0) + ((count(cluster_operator_conditions{condition="Progressing"} == 1) or vector(0)) > bool 0), 1)), 2) and on() ((max((up{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main"}) < 180))) == 1) and on() (max((up{job="cluster-version-operator"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="cluster-version-operator"}) < 180))) == 1) and on() (max((up{job="prometheus-k8s"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="prometheus-k8s"}) < 180))) == 1) and on() (max((ALERTS{alertname="Watchdog",alertstate="firing"} and (time() - timestamp(ALERTS{alertname="Watchdog",alertstate="firing"}) < 180))) == 1) and on() (count((cluster_operator_conditions{condition="Available"} and (time() - timestamp(cluster_operator_conditions{condition="Available"}) < 180))) > 0))) or vector(-1)

panels.title: Ready nodes / 4
panels.description: Expected: ms-02, ms-03, ms-04, tr-gpu. Missing node series count as not Ready when kube-state-metrics is healthy.

targets.expr: (sum(max by (node) ((kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status="true",node=~"ms\\-02|ms\\-03|ms\\-04|tr\\-gpu"} and (time() - timestamp(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status="true",node=~"ms\\-02|ms\\-03|ms\\-04|tr\\-gpu"}) < 180)))) or vector(0)) and on() ((max((up{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main"}) < 180))) == 1))

panels.title: Operator problems
panels.description: Zero is shown only when monitoring sources and the Watchdog heartbeat are available. Operator problems count distinct operators, including the version operator Failing condition.

targets.expr: ((count(count by (name) (cluster_operator_conditions{condition="Available"} == 0 or cluster_operator_conditions{condition=~"Degraded|Failing"} == 1)) or vector(0))) and on() ((max((up{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="kube-state-metrics",endpoint="https-main"}) < 180))) == 1) and on() (max((up{job="cluster-version-operator"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="cluster-version-operator"}) < 180))) == 1) and on() (max((up{job="prometheus-k8s"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="prometheus-k8s"}) < 180))) == 1) and on() (max((ALERTS{alertname="Watchdog",alertstate="firing"} and (time() - timestamp(ALERTS{alertname="Watchdog",alertstate="firing"}) < 180))) == 1) and on() (count((cluster_operator_conditions{condition="Available"} and (time() - timestamp(cluster_operator_conditions{condition="Available"}) < 180))) > 0))

panels.description: An empty table means no active warning/critical alerts only if Cluster health has known data. Watchdog and informational alerts are omitted.

panels.title: Operator problems
panels.description: Available=0 or Degraded/Failing=1. An empty table means no problems only when Cluster health has known data.

panels.title: Node network receive
panels.description: Five-minute average bits/s per node and interface. Physical Ethernet interfaces (en*/eth*) separately, including idle ports; virtual interfaces are excluded. Rates handle counter resets and require two samples. Failed scrapes or samples older than 180 seconds show gaps; idle interfaces remain zero. No cluster traffic total is inferred.

targets.expr: 8 * max by (instance, device) ((rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{job="node-exporter",instance=~"ms\\-02|ms\\-03|ms\\-04|tr\\-gpu",device=~"en.*|eth.*"}[5m]) and (node_network_receive_bytes_total{job="node-exporter",instance=~"ms\\-02|ms\\-03|ms\\-04|tr\\-gpu",device=~"en.*|eth.*"} and (time() - timestamp(node_network_receive_bytes_total{job="node-exporter",instance=~"ms\\-02|ms\\-03|ms\\-04|tr\\-gpu",device=~"en.*|eth.*"}) < 180))) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="node-exporter",instance=~"ms\\-02|ms\\-03|ms\\-04|tr\\-gpu"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="node-exporter",instance=~"ms\\-02|ms\\-03|ms\\-04|tr\\-gpu"}) < 180)) == 1))
